preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
How much should the trip cost?
What kind of food should the plan be built around?

description: Q4, mixed-values user who states pace, night, food (high side) at turn 0; turn 1 corrects budget (low side).

turns.user: Can you plan a weekend in Tokyo for me? I like to pack in as much as I can. I love late nights out. I'll eat anything and love trying adventurous local food.
That's too expensive for me. I'm on a tight budget, so keep it cheap. Can you redo it?
Great. I've decided to stay an extra day. Can you plan Monday too?
A friend is joining me on Saturday. Can you redo Saturday for the two of us?
